plugins.name: ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Spec-driven SDLC (at-sdlc) routed across skill libraries, a private knowledge base kept protected and indexed (at-search, at-sleep), a feel loop for games, a real-world (non-coding) execution method for deadline-bound tasks, a Suno workflow for re-lyricing a reference song, an independent-judgment stance for any conversation, and universal coding principles.
